# Vendored Ruckig

- Upstream: https://github.com/pantor/ruckig
- Version: v0.15.3
- Commit: `37b6e7a4c60f5befd2506741d5f7d0ae7eefb3db`
- License: MIT (`LICENSE` in this directory)

This C++17-compatible community release is vendored so the robot console does
not need network access or a system package at configure/build time. Examples,
tests, and the cloud client are disabled by the parent CMake project.
